title: CodeBuddy Product Line Upgraded to the Official Version of DeepSeek-V4-Pro
excerpt: Today, CodeBuddy announced that WorkBuddy, as well as the full series of CodeBuddy IDE, plugins, and CLI products, have been fully upgraded to the official vers
content_html:
Today, CodeBuddy announced that WorkBuddy, as well as the full series of CodeBuddy IDE, plugins, and CLI products, have been fully upgraded to the official version of DeepSeek-V4-Pro, providing developers with the latest model capabilities.

The official also announced a price adjustment notice, stating that the DeepSeek V4 series will undergo a price change soon. It is recommended that users plan their model usage needs in advance and complete relevant deployments within the current pricing window.

This upgrade covers the multi-terminal product system of CodeBuddy. With the DeepSeek V4 series entering the official version and preparing for a price adjustment, its application costs in AI programming and intelligent development scenarios will also be affected.

content_html_zh:
今天，CodeBuddy宣布WorkBuddy以及CodeBuddy全系列IDE、插件、CLI产品已全面升级至DeepSeek-V4-Pro正式版，为开发者提供最新的模型能力。

官方还发布了调价通知，表示DeepSeek V4系列即将进行调价。 建议用户提前规划模型使用需求，并在当前定价窗口内完成相关部署。

本次升级涵盖CodeBuddy多终端产品体系。 随着DeepSeek V4系列进入正式版本并准备调价，其在AI编程和智能开发场景的应用成本也将受到影响。
